wrong_claims: Permission sets with Create/Edit on Promotion__c are Agentforce_Reference_App and sfdc_accelerate_dms (reported by AskCoworker). ObjectPermissions shows Create/Edit only for sfdc_accelerate_dms and the System Administrator profile. Agentforce_Reference_App has no ObjectPermissions row on Promotion__c.

defects.defect: An unverified AskCoworker claim about which permission sets can create or edit Promotion__c was kept in Section 2 Grounding. It was labelled 'reported by AskCoworker' and marked as not needed, but it is wrong: Agentforce_Reference_App has no access. A single ObjectPermissions query would have caught it.
defects.skill_gap: The skill should say to drop unverified AskCoworker facts that the design does not need, or verify them if they are cheap to check, rather than list them in Grounding.
